id: \rHello, and welcome to the Pokémon Center.
en: \rHello, and welcome to the Pokémon Center.
it: \rCiao, benvenuto al Centro Pokémon.

id: \rWe restore your tired Pokémon to full health.
en: \rWe restore your tired Pokémon to full health.
it: \rQui rimettiamo in forze i tuoi Pokémon stanchi.

id: \rWould you like to rest your Pokémon?
en: \rWould you like to rest your Pokémon?
it: \rVuoi far riposare i tuoi Pokémon?

id: \rOK, I'll take your Pokémon for a few seconds.
en: \rOK, I'll take your Pokémon for a few seconds.
it: \rBene, prendo i tuoi Pokémon per qualche secondo.

id: \rYour Pokémon may be infected by PokeRus.
en: \rYour Pokémon may be infected by PokeRus.
it: \rI tuoi Pokémon potrebbero aver contratto il Pokérus.

id: \rLittle is known about the PokeRus except that they are microscopic life-forms that attach to Pokémon.
en: \rLittle is known about the PokeRus except that they are microscopic life-forms that attach to Pokémon.
it: \rSi sa poco del Pokérus, se non che si tratta di forme di vita microscopiche che si attaccano ai Pokémon.

id: \rWhile infected, Pokémon are said to grow exceptionally well.
en: \rWhile infected, Pokémon are said to grow exceptionally well.
it: \rSi dice che i Pokémon infetti crescano eccezionalmente bene.

id: \rThank you for waiting.
en: \rThank you for waiting.
it: \rGrazie per l'attesa.

id: \rWe've restored your Pokémon to full health.
en: \rWe've restored your Pokémon to full health.
it: \rI tuoi Pokémon sono di nuovo in piena forma.

id: \rWe hope to see you again!
en: \rWe hope to see you again!
it: \rTorna a trovarci!

id: \rFirst, you should restore your Pokémon to full health.
en: \rFirst, you should restore your Pokémon to full health.
it: \rPer prima cosa, dovresti rimettere in forze i tuoi Pokémon.

id: \rYour Pokémon have been healed to perfect health.
en: \rYour Pokémon have been healed to perfect health.
it: \rI tuoi Pokémon sono stati curati e sono in perfetta salute.

id: \rWe hope you excel!
en: \rWe hope you excel!
it: \rSpero che tu abbia successo!

id: Which heading would you like to read?\ch[1,-1, Stadium Cups,Pika Cup,Fancy Cup, Poké Cup,Little Cup,Battle Rules,Exit]
en: Which heading would you like to read?\ch[1,-1, Stadium Cups,Pika Cup,Fancy Cup, Poké Cup,Little Cup,Battle Rules,Exit]

id: This facility lets you conduct battles similar to Stadium championships.
en: This facility lets you conduct battles similar to Stadium championships.
it: Questa struttura permette di disputare lotte simili ai campionati di Stadium.

id: This facility holds battles for Pika Cup, Fancy Cup, Poké Cup, and Little Cup. Each cup has its own rules and restrictions.
en: This facility holds battles for Pika Cup, Fancy Cup, Poké Cup, and Little Cup.  Each cup has its own rules and restrictions.
it: Questa struttura ospita lotte per la Coppa Pika, la Coppa Baby, la Coppa Poké e la Coppa Mini.  Ogni coppa ha le sue regole e restrizioni.

id: The Pika Cup is open to Pokémon level 15 to 20.
en: The Pika Cup is open to Pokémon level 15 to 20.
it: La Coppa Pika è aperta ai Pokémon dal livello 15 al 20.

id: Choose three Pokémon to enter.\n However, the total level of all three can't be higher than 50.
en: Choose three Pokémon to enter.\n However, the total level of all three can't be higher than 50.
it: Scegli tre Pokémon da iscrivere.\n Però la somma dei livelli dei tre non può superare 50.

id: Also, certain exotic kinds of Pokémon may not enter.
en: Also, certain exotic kinds of Pokémon may not enter.
it: Inoltre, alcuni tipi di Pokémon esotici non possono partecipare.

id: The Fancy Cup is open to baby Pokémon level 25 to 30.
en: The Fancy Cup is open to baby Pokémon level 25 to 30.
it: La Coppa Baby è aperta ai Pokémon baby dal livello 25 al 30.

id: Choose three Pokémon to enter.\n However, the total level of all three can't be higher than 80.
en: Choose three Pokémon to enter.\n However, the total level of all three can't be higher than 80.
it: Scegli tre Pokémon da iscrivere.\n Però la somma dei livelli dei tre non può superare 80.

id: Also, very huge or very tall Pokémon may not enter the Fancy Cup.
en: Also, very huge or very tall Pokémon may not enter the Fancy Cup.
it: Inoltre, i Pokémon molto grossi o molto alti non possono partecipare alla Coppa Baby.

id: The height limit is 2 meters, and the weight limit is 20 kilograms for the Fancy Cup.
en: The height limit is 2 meters, and the weight limit is 20 kilograms for the Fancy Cup.
it: Per la Coppa Baby il limite di altezza è di 2 metri e il limite di peso è di 20 chilogrammi.

id: The Poké Cup is open to Pokémon level 50 to 55.
en: The Poké Cup is open to Pokémon level 50 to 55.
it: La Coppa Poké è aperta ai Pokémon dal livello 50 al 55.

id: Choose three Pokémon to enter.\n However, the total level of all three can't be higher than 155.
en: Choose three Pokémon to enter.\n However, the total level of all three can't be higher than 155.
it: Scegli tre Pokémon da iscrivere.\n Però la somma dei livelli dei tre non può superare 155.

id: The Little Cup is open to baby Pokémon at level 5 that are capable of evolving.
en: The Little Cup is open to baby Pokémon at level 5 that are capable of evolving.
it: La Coppa Mini è aperta ai Pokémon baby di livello 5 in grado di evolversi.

id: Choose three Pokémon to enter a single battle, or four for a double battle.
en: Choose three Pokémon to enter a single battle, or four for a double battle.
it: Scegli tre Pokémon da iscrivere per una lotta singola, o quattro per una lotta in doppio.

id: Also, in the Little Cup, moves that deal a set amount of damage, like Dragon Rage and SonicBoom, will always miss.
en: Also, in the Little Cup, moves that deal a set amount of damage, like Dragon Rage and SonicBoom, will always miss.
it: Inoltre, nella Coppa Mini le mosse che infliggono una quantità fissa di danni, come Ira di Drago e Sonicboom, falliranno sempre.

id: In Stadium Cups, there are several rules to keep in mind.
en: In Stadium Cups, there are several rules to keep in mind.
it: Nelle Coppe Stadio ci sono diverse regole da tenere a mente.

id: First, two Pokémon in the same team can't be both asleep or both frozen at the same time.
en: First, two Pokémon in the same team can't be both asleep or both frozen at the same time.
it: Primo, due Pokémon della stessa squadra non possono essere entrambi addormentati o entrambi congelati nello stesso momento.

id: Also, you can't choose two of the same kind of Pokémon, or two Pokémon holding the same item.
en: Also, you can't choose two of the same kind of Pokémon, or two Pokémon holding the same item.
it: Inoltre, non puoi scegliere due Pokémon della stessa specie o due Pokémon che tengono lo stesso strumento.

id: Finally, if a Pokémon uses Selfdestruct or Explosion to make all remaining Pokémon faint at the same time, that Pokémon's trainer loses.
en: Finally, if a Pokémon uses Selfdestruct or Explosion to make all remaining Pokémon faint at the same time, that Pokémon's trainer loses.
it: Infine, se un Pokémon usa Autodistruzione o Esplosione e fa esaurire tutti i Pokémon rimasti nello stesso momento, il suo allenatore perde.

id: There is no battle recorded.
en: There is no battle recorded.
it: Non è stata registrata nessuna lotta.

en: \rWelcome to the Battle Tower's Stadium Cup Division.
